The '''VX-736 injector''' was an experimental vaccine for [[Womp Rat fever]], manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], which cured the fever and made the user temporally immune. As a side-effect, the injection increased the rate of natural regeneration.<ref name="TOR" />
